actual_contract.message_id: Globally unique Dramatiq message identity is built in.
actual_contract.root_identity: No WIC ROOT semantic or immutable ROOT field is built in; it must be carried in args, kwargs, or options by integration code.
actual_contract.receive_observable: Broker/worker processing is observable, but no WIC TOOL044 receive receipt is emitted as supplied.
actual_contract.ack: Worker calls consumer.ack(message) after processing; this is broker acknowledgement, not the required TOOL044 receive ACK.
actual_contract.readback: Results middleware can read a result by message identity, but result storage defaults off and requires a configured backend.
actual_contract.duplicate_and_loss: Broker semantics help delivery handling but do not by themselves implement WIC JOB/ROOT deduplication and closed-loop ACK read-back.
